title: 1. Global Context
use_cases: Use when maintaining strict character and location naming across multiple generation cycles
Configure when setting global rules and stylistic constraints for a creative project
Implement when preventing data drift in state-dependent narrative outputs
content:
This is the stuff that must never drift, no matter what page you are on. In a screenplay, this is your “Source of Truth”: character names, the rules of the world, and the specific stylistic constraints you’ve set.

- The Fix: We call this The Bible. It is a structured object passed to every single generation call to put a hard lock on names, props, and locations.
- The Problem: If “John” becomes “ZEUS” in Scene 1, he better not revert to “John” in Scene 50.
